INSERT INTO CHAT_ROOM ( ROOM_ID, PRODUCT_ID, SELLER_ID, BUYER_ID, CREATED_AT, LAST_MESSAGE, LAST_MESSAGE_AT ) VALUES ( #{roomId}, #{productId}, #{sellerId}, #{buyerId}, SYSDATE, NULL, NULL )
mapper.select:
SELECT r.ROOM_ID AS roomId, r.PRODUCT_ID AS productId, r.SELLER_ID AS sellerId, r.BUYER_ID AS buyerId, r.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, r.LAST_MESSAGE_AT AS lastMessageAt, r.LAST_MESSAGE AS lastMessage,
p.TITLE AS productTitle, p.PRICE AS price, p.STATUS AS status,
(SELECT IMAGE_PATH FROM PRODUCT_IMAGES WHERE PRODUCT_ID = r.PRODUCT_ID AND ORDERS = 1 ) AS productImageUrl
FROM CHAT_ROOM r JOIN PRODUCT p ON r.PRODUCT_ID = p.PRODUCT_ID WHERE r.ROOM_ID = #{roomId}

SELECT r.ROOM_ID AS roomId, r.PRODUCT_ID AS productId, r.SELLER_ID AS sellerId, r.BUYER_ID AS buyerId, r.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, r.LAST_MESSAGE_AT AS lastMessageAt, r.LAST_MESSAGE AS lastMessage,
p.TITLE AS productTitle, p.PRICE AS price, p.STATUS AS status,
(SELECT IMAGE_PATH FROM PRODUCT_IMAGES WHERE PRODUCT_ID = r.PRODUCT_ID AND ORDERS = 1 ) AS productImageUrl
FROM CHAT_ROOM r JOIN PRODUCT p ON r.PRODUCT_ID = p.PRODUCT_ID WHERE r.PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} AND r.SELLER_ID = #{sellerId} AND r.BUYER_ID = #{buyerId}

SELECT r.ROOM_ID AS roomId, r.PRODUCT_ID AS productId, r.SELLER_ID AS sellerId, r.BUYER_ID AS buyerId, r.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, r.LAST_MESSAGE_AT AS lastMessageAt, r.LAST_MESSAGE AS lastMessage,
-- 🎯 상품 정보 p.TITLE AS productTitle, p.PRICE AS price, p.STATUS AS status,
-- 🎯 대표 이미지 (1번 이미지) (SELECT IMAGE_PATH FROM PRODUCT_IMAGES WHERE PRODUCT_ID = r.PRODUCT_ID AND ORDERS = 1 ) AS productImageUrl,
-- 🎯 각 방별 미읽은 메시지 수 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_MESSAGE m WHERE m.ROOM_ID = r.ROOM_ID AND m.SENDER_ID != #{userId} AND m.IS_READ = 'N' ) AS unreadCount
FROM CHAT_ROOM r JOIN PRODUCT p ON r.PRODUCT_ID = p.PRODUCT_ID WHERE r.SELLER_ID = #{userId} OR r.BUYER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY r.LAST_MESSAGE_AT DESC NULLS LAST
